rationale: Paralog carry-over from the PANTHER DAPDC node. BT_0674 has Leu310 where both authentic DAPDCs (B. theta LysA Glu335, E. coli LysA Glu343) have Glu, and the genome already encodes an authentic lysA (BT_1374, Q8A800) carrying the same IBA plus UniProt IEA.
Same carry-over. Lysine biosynthesis in this organism runs through BT_1374.
Name-based transfer from TIGR01047 nspC. The C. jejuni orthologue with the same pocket makes spermidine in vivo (PMID:22025614) and B. theta casdc deletion depletes spermidine (PMID:27118128).
Directly supported by the deletion phenotype in the target organism.

lead_action: RETAIN as the most specific available MF
rationale: No GO term exists for EC 4.1.1.96. GO:0016831 is the most specific term the ontology currently offers for this activity.
The reaction is in Rhea (RHEA:34095, RHEA:34099) and the partner step already has GO:0102143 carboxynorspermidine dehydrogenase activity, so the decarboxylase term is a gap.
Lys42 is the Schiff-base lysine by alignment to 3N29 Lys41 (LINK NZ-C4A 1.53 A); Glu239, Gly206-Gly207, His171, Tyr338 complete the PLP site. Evidence is ISS, not experimental.
